europe_now.title: NATO Intercepts Drone Over Lithuania
europe_now.summary: NATO jets successfully downed a drone over Lithuania while a Russian ship separately fired flares at a Danish helicopter. These regional security incidents have prompted analysts to call for a stronger and more decisive response against Russia.

sources.headline: NATO jets down drone over Lithuania as Russian ship fires flares at Danish helicopter
Analysts call for step-up in response to Russia after Denmark, Lithuania incidents

europe_now.title: German Political Crisis Intensifies
europe_now.summary: German leader Friedrich Merz cancelled a planned trip to New York as he faces mounting domestic political pressure and an escalating crisis. The cancellation underscores the severity of the leadership challenges currently confronting the German government.

sources.headline: Germany’s embattled leader Merz cancels New York trip amid mounting domestic pressure

top_stories.title: Volcanic Ash Disrupts Air Travel in Italy
top_stories.summary: Mount Etna erupted and released volcanic ash that grounded flights at a Sicilian airport. Passengers experienced significant travel disruptions as aviation authorities managed the hazardous conditions.

sources.headline: Ash from Mount Etna grounds flights at Sicily airport

top_stories.title: European Parliament Revokes Immunity for Polish MEP
top_stories.summary: The European Parliament voted to lift parliamentary immunity for a Polish far-right leader. The affected member faces charges related to Holocaust denial.
